# Workflow authoring

Workflows are JavaScript orchestration programs that the `subagents` tool runs from its `script` or `name` input. The table below is generated from the extension's executable capability contract, so its names, signatures, options, and defaults match the installed runtime.

Use the packaged `workflow-authoring` skill for pattern selection, lifecycle rules, review and debugging guidance, and adaptable examples. Those explanations remain hand-written. Configured model routes and agent types are dynamic references; obtain their names and purposes from the active user or project context rather than this static page.

[`workflow-context-surfaces.json`](workflow-context-surfaces.json) records the generated byte sizes of the always-on prompt, the provider-visible tool definitions, skill discovery entries, and the on-demand skill corpus. Regenerate it with `npm run context:generate` after changing any of them.
